record.question: Which of the following best describes why participation in play activities is important to children's growth and development?
options: Children learn how to behave by observing older children at play.
Play settings provide the environments in which overcome confusion related to appearance.
Children with limited opportunities to play often experience delayed development.
Play allows children to try out new physical, cognitive, and social behaviors.
